question: How can a solid piece of titanium bend 180 degrees?
answer: The titanium is one piece of 3D-printed metal, designed with thin, flexible beams. Those beams let the solid metal bend ±90°, which gives 180° of motion, and then it springs back. No hinge or alloy is needed; the shape does the work.
move: The right shape can make even solid metal bend.

web.label: An interactive card with a draggable knob. Dragging it bends a solid titanium bar, with no hinge visible, from full left to full right. The page asks the reader to bend it all the way left, then all the way right.

source: Veritasium, “Why Machines That Bend Are Better” (YouTube, 2019)
